posts.content: 培訓頁面：Brown 大學 CME 免費網上研討會，2026 年 12 月 2 日美東時間 11:00–12:15，Zoom 線上直播。
posts.title: AI and Mental Health: Consumer Use, Clinical Use Cases, and Ethical Considerations

summary_en: A free 75-minute live webinar from Brown University's Warren Alpert Medical School (Department of Psychiatry and Human Behavior Grand Rounds), presented by Professor Shannon Wiltsey-Stirman of Stanford University. It reviews the state of the evidence for AI-based training and psychotherapy tools, the factors to evaluate before using large language model (LLM) based technologies for psychotherapy, and three use cases for LLMs to support implementation. Held Wednesday 2 December 2026, 11:00-12:15 Eastern Time (00:00-01:15 Hong Kong/Macau time on 3 December), fully online via Zoom, free of charge, in English, with advance pre-registration required. Offers 1.25 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits. Aimed at physicians, psychologists, psychiatrists, physician assistants, residents and fellows.
summary_zh: Brown 大學 Warren Alpert 醫學院精神科 Grand Rounds 免費 75 分鐘網上研討會，由史丹福大學 Shannon Wiltsey-Stirman 教授主講。講解 AI 心理治療工具嘅證據現況、考慮用大型語言模型（LLM）做心理治療前要評估嘅重要因素，以及三個 LLM 支援治療實施嘅實際應用場景。2026 年 12 月 2 日（星期三）美東時間 11:00–12:15 舉行（香港／澳門時間 12 月 3 日星期四凌晨 12:00–1:15），全程 Zoom 線上直播，費用全免，全程英語，須預先報名。可獲 1.25 AMA PRA Category 1 學分。對象為醫生、心理學家、精神科醫生、醫科助理、住院醫生及研究員。
